messages:
zoe: FYI I hit a packaging weirdness — lockfile worked on my mac but CI failed installing a wheel.
ana: details?
zoe: poetry.lock came from mac arm64; CI linux tried to pick a cp311 manylinux wheel incompatible with our py310 image.
chris: classic marker mismatch. Did pyproject use sys_platform or platform_machine markers?
zoe: yes, some optional deps use markers. Example: async-client = {version="0.4", markers="python_version >= \"3.10\" and sys_platform != \"win32\""}
ana: if lock generated on mac, resolver excludes linux-only artifacts. CI should export for target platform.
chris: practical fixes: 1) generate lock in a linux container 2) use `poetry export --platform manylinux2014_x86_64` in CI 3) add an async import smoke test.
zoe: temp workaround: force `pip install --no-binary somelib` in CI to build from sdist.
bot-ci: created ticket DEVEX-417: "poetry lock regen + platform export in CI"
ana: also recommend non-editable installs in CI to catch missing extras.
zoe: will open docs PR with checklist. Thanks! :thumbsup:
